goal: Add the recipes from recipes.txt in Markor that take 30 mins to prepare into the Broccoli recipe app.
summary:
I added three recipes to Broccoli. They're the only ones in recipes.txt with a 30 mins prep time, and each has all its fields copied exactly as the file gives them:

1. **Quick Fried Rice**: 2 servings, 30 mins, ingredients "quantities to taste". Description: "A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day."
2. **Lentil Soup**: 6 servings, 30 mins, ingredients "as needed". Description: "A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays."
3. **Moroccan Chickpea Stew**: 3-4 servings, 30 mins, ingredients "see directions". Description: "A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day."

The file has other recipes with the same names (Quick Fried Rice, Lentil Soup and Moroccan Chickpea Stew each appear more than once), but the other copies have different prep times, so I left them out.

The typing tool turned "Sauté" into "Saute" in two of the directions. I swapped the word for the keyboard's "Sauté" suggestion before saving, so the accent matches the file in all three. Each recipe's detail screen showed the saved values.
